providers.title: Basic properties of quasitraces
providers.scope: A 1-quasitrace is positive and monotone on commuting self-adjoint elements; every 1-quasitrace on M_2 extending a normalized 2-quasitrace takes the value 2 at the unit; every tracial state is a normalized 2-quasitrace.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Properly infinite algebras have no quasitraces
providers.scope: A properly infinite unital C*-algebra has no normalized 1-quasitrace.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A uniform additivity defect
providers.scope: If x_1, ..., x_N in a unital C*-algebra B satisfy sum x_i* x_i = 1 and sum x_i x_i* <= c 1 with c < 1, explicit positive contractions a, b in M_2N(B) satisfy tau(a + b) - tau(a) - tau(b) >= (1 - c)/(2N) for every normalized 1-quasitrace tau on M_2N(B).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A counterexample to the quasitrace conjecture
providers.scope: Assume (CBH) (Cuntz, Blackadar and Handelman; not proved in the programme) and (SM) (facts on smooth manifolds; not proved in the course). There are a separable unital C*-algebra A with normalized 2-quasitraces and positive contractions a, b in A with tau(a + b) - tau(a) - tau(b) >= 1/144 for every normalized 2-quasitrace tau; A has no tracial state. Without (CBH) the inequality holds for every normalized 1-quasitrace.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Smooth images of smaller manifolds are null
providers.scope: Assume (SM). The image of a smooth manifold of dimension a under a smooth map to R^n with a < n has Lebesgue measure zero.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The incidence lemma
providers.scope: Assume (SM). For smooth Hermitian bundles E, F of ranks d, r over a compact smooth manifold of real dimension 2h and finitely many pairs (s, t) with (qs - t)(r - t) - s(d - s) > h, there are smooth bundle maps T_1, ..., T_q from E to F such that the images of every s-dimensional subspace of a fiber span a space of dimension greater than t.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The min-max principle
providers.scope: The k-th largest eigenvalue of a Hermitian matrix is the largest mu for which some k-dimensional subspace has quadratic form at least mu; eigenvalues are monotone and 1-Lipschitz in the matrix.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A determinant expansion
providers.scope: det(I + CC*) is the sum over all sets J of columns of C of the Gram determinants of the columns in J.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The normalization lemma
providers.scope: If bundle maps T_1, ..., T_n from E to F over a compact Hausdorff space double the dimension of every subspace of every fiber, there are bundle maps X_i with sum X_i* X_i = I and sum X_i X_i* <= (2/3) I; by Remark 6.2 every bound c > 1/2 can replace 2/3.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Subbundles and orthogonal complements
providers.scope: If p is a bundle map of a Hermitian bundle G whose values are orthogonal projections, the images of p and of I - p are vector bundles and G is isomorphic to their direct sum.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Cohomology of a product of projective spaces
providers.scope: For Y = CP^K_1 x ... x CP^K_R and x_i = -c_1 of the pulled back tautological line bundles, the monomials x_1^e_1 ... x_R^e_R with 0 <= e_i <= K_i form a basis of H*(Y; Z).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A Chern class obstruction
providers.scope: A Hermitian bundle over Y isomorphic to L_0^h_0 + L_1^K_1 + ... + L_R^K_R, with L_0 trivial and L_i the pulled back tautological line bundles, contains no trivial subbundle of rank greater than h_0.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Bundle tests
providers.scope: Assume (SM). For m, R >= 1 there are a compact smooth manifold Y, Hermitian bundles E_j with E_0 trivial of rank d_0 = 64 m 4^R, and 24 bundle maps from E_j to E_(j+1) at every level with sum X* X = I and sum X X* <= (2/3) I, such that (E_0 + ... + E_R)^m contains no trivial subbundle of rank 2 m d_0. Seven maps suffice (Remark 6.2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: No properly infinite matrix algebra
providers.scope: Assume (SM). The C*-algebra B generated by the weighted shifts of all bundle tests is separable, its 24 generators satisfy sum x_i* x_i = 1 and sum x_i x_i* <= (2/3) 1, and no matrix algebra M_m(B) is properly infinite.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A sharper constant
providers.scope: Assume (SM). For every c in (1/2, 1) there is a separable unital C*-algebra with seven generators, sum x_i* x_i = 1, sum x_i x_i* <= c 1 and no properly infinite matrix algebra; every normalized 1-quasitrace on its 14 x 14 matrices has additivity defect at least (1 - c)/14 on an explicit pair.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
